name: Yufu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yufu city emblem in green and orange: a green stylised figure with outstretched leaf-like arms and an orange head.
history: Municipal flag of Yufu, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Yufu city emblem — a green stylised figure with outstretched leaf-like arms and an orange head
